headline: Festival Giveaways
cta_text: AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE DAY OF FESTIVAL
description: The Desert Grey Festival Giveaway runs throughout festival day, with 8–10 live drawings for sponsor-donated prizes, gift bags, experiences, gift cards, and branded gear. Fans can purchase giveaway entries at the festival, and winners will be announced live from the main stage throughout the day. You must be present to win, so stick around and listen for your name.
